title: How to Train Your Dragon
synopsis: The island of Olukh is inhabited by a tribe of Vikings led by Chief Stoik. The biggest problem of the island is the constant dragon raids that burn the village and steal food. Stoik's son, Ikking, is an unusual Viking; he is weaker than the others and struggles with dragon slaying. The chief sends him for training with Gobber and other young Vikings. One day, Ikking accidentally manages to take down the mystical dragon Night Fury, which no one has been able to catch before. He finds the fallen dragon but is unable to kill it and lets it go. Since then, Ikking begins to study Night Fury, using the tricks he learned during training, gradually becoming the best at handling dragons. Ikking grows closer to the Fury, names it Toothless, and even learns to fly on it. Thus, Ikking starts to understand that everything they know about dragons is not true, but the question arises: how to convince a clan that has been at war with dragons for centuries?
